decision_rules.PARTIAL: Title implies a review but does not clearly state systematic review/meta-analysis.

decision_rules.YES: Abstract substantially follows PRISMA for Abstracts with most required elements present.
decision_rules.PARTIAL: Abstract reports some required elements but important parts are missing (e.g., search sources/dates, registration, RoB).
decision_rules.NO: Abstract lacks core systematic review reporting elements.
